blocks.tamil_translation: to fulfil in their hearts, death comes to them while they are unable to fulfil those needs. On the Day of Qiyamah Allah Ta'ala will say to the angels, “Go to them and greet them with Salam.” The angels (in astonishment) will ask, “Our Lord! We are the dwellers of Your heavens and the best of Your creation. (Even so) You command us to go to them and greet them with Salam?” (What is the reason for this?) Allah Ta'ala will say, “These are the ones who used to worship Me. They did not associate anyone with Me. Through them the frontiers were guarded. In difficult matters (by putting them in front) protection was carried out through them. Death came to them while the desire to fulfil their needs was still in their hearts, and they were unable to fulfil those needs.' So the angels will then come to them from every gate, saying, “Peace be upon you because you were patient! How excellent has become your final outcome in this world!”” — Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: سَيَأْتِي أُنَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ نُورُهُمْ كَضَوْءِ الشَّمْسِ، قُلْنَا: مَنْ أُولئِكَ يَارَسُولَ اللهِ؟ فَقَالَ: فُقَرَاءُ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ الَّذِينَ تُتَّقَي بِهِمُ الْمَكَارِهُ، يَمُوتُ أَحَدُهُمْ وَحَاجَتُهُ فِي صَدْرِهِ يُحْشَرُونَ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ اْلَاَرْضِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “On the Day of Qiyamah some people from my Ummah will come whose light will be like the light of the sun
